run_rationale: All 10 candidates fail the Tier-2 floor (PF≥1.5, WR≥50%, MDD<20%, n≥100). The primary blocker is catastrophic sample size: n ranges from 7 to 17, far below the 100-trade minimum. This is likely an artifact of the simplified signal translation (SMA-crossover proxy instead of faithful spec.entry parsing) combined with the 5-year backtest window on commodity ETFs that trade infrequently relative to the strategy logic. While several candidates show promising PF (2.22-3.5) and WR (40-66.7%), the MDD is excessive (15.9-54.8%) and trade counts are statistically meaningless. The P4 cross-tests showing independence are irrelevant at these sample sizes. Retry conditions: (1) implement faithful-signal translator (v3 queue) to generate realistic trade frequency, (2) extend backtest window beyond 5 years if data available, (3) re-run with minimum 100-trade threshold before evaluating PF/WR/MDD. No candidate warrants wiring into production.
